Definition: Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel
BiblicalUsage: Jeshurun is a poetic name for Israel, used when Moses speaks of the people God chose and carried. In Deuteronomy 32:15, Jeshurun waxed fat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jeshurun is a name of love, given to a people who kept wandering, and it tells me God names His own with affection.
